review_method: Rendered every prepared image beside its paired mask in contact sheets and visually reviewed all sheets.
pair_inventory_check: passed; 1914 images and 1914 masks paired by split, class, and sample ID

findings.class_content_match: No obvious class-level content mismatch or unrelated image was observed in the visual review.
findings.mask_correspondence: Masks generally follow the visible fruit foreground and are suitable for introductory foreground-segmentation exercises.
findings.mask_scope_variation: Small stems, calyxes, and leafy crowns are included inconsistently across examples; pineapple crown inclusion varies. Some fruit touch or extend to image edges, and masks follow the visible crop.
findings.boundary_precision: Contact-sheet inspection supports broad alignment only; it is not a pixel-level boundary accuracy assessment. The source audit records antialiased grayscale boundary values.

rights_review.status: CC BY 4.0 source claim remains verified as recorded in the full audit; final redistribution record remains pending

release_decision: Hold public artifact release and library API pending final rights record and segmentation adapter. This visual review does not change that hold.
